title: Improving the start menu
author: ongix
selftext:
Got a lot of good feedback that the old (top) start model was too AI. Bottom background renders by the engine completely. 

Still got a lot of rough edges  to tune mainly asset-wise but WDYT?

comments.author: tist006
comments.body: I would think it depends on the game aesthetic. The top to me feels like some realistic aaa game and bottom more indie.

comments.author: enginearchitect
comments.body: old looks better imo

replies.author: LeloucheL
replies.body: yeah it does objectively. but its way too Ai looking

comments.author: TheBigQuestion354
comments.body: I’d remove the Tirdent AI image. Your bottom image actually looks way better in the “less AI” way but the trident still looks very AI. Only recommending this because you appear to want to go away from the AI generated look and that’s the main thing that still sticks out.

replies.author: TheBigQuestion354
replies.body: By the way, I like the new look, my menu looks somewhat similar

replies.author: ongix
replies.body: Yeah I can see that now lol 100% thanks!

replies.author: KaleidoscopeDue7179
replies.body: I dont think the trident logo is bad, its just too close to the text, it needs to be smaller to make space between text and logo

comments.author: Freezemoon
comments.body:
old one might look a bit better but also have a bigger AI feels. 

I believe the new one does have this indie vibe which is good to have, people would adjust their expectations and may be less critical of your game.

comments.author: jivenossauro
comments.body: Bottom feels way better to me. The top one looks overcooked, like literally overcooked it has so much grain the table looks like a burnt steak

comments.author: SleepingCod
comments.body: I like the old personally

replies.author: Cpt_Tripps
replies.body: it screams AI generated which is a turn off for a lot of people.

comments.author: Mubeenization
comments.body: Old is gold. Attracting much more attention. Atleast for me.

comments.author: morfidon
comments.body: I liked top more

comments.author: MaxwellHowl
comments.body:
Yeah, I do my best to keep all images like that top one out of my creations.  It looks so bad.  I really hope Imagen 3 fixes it.  It's clearly a watermark, it makes everything clearly AI, it all looks bad, it ruins every image. 

My new workflow is to try Nano Banana.  If that doesn't work, use Imagen.  Then run that through nanobanana to remove this watermark.  Works a lot of the time.

comments.author: bugnetio
comments.body: Nice you got the smoke in the background animated :), I think it looks good! Do agree with removing the trident!

replies.author: ongix
replies.body: You have a good eye for this haha thanks!

comments.author: Double_Suggestion385
comments.body: Old one is way better.

comments.author: fyrefreezer01
comments.body: Can you just draw the top art? Or are you not capable? I mean you already have the idea just make it look more human, don’t generate it.

comments.author: mrdarknezz1
comments.body: I prefer the new one

comments.author: Dangerous-Eye-215
comments.body: I think the old looks better. I dont give a shit about whether or not it looks AI if it looks good.

replies.author: Kalaminator
replies.body: Exactly, the new one looks some 2000' game, I like the first one better.

replies.author: BuildAnything4
replies.body: i think that's the point, the first one looks very ai generated, which is probably the look OP is trying to avoid.

comments.author: LukeLikesReddit
comments.body: Old one looks miles better, just run desharpening/desaturation, add some atmospheric mist into it like you have with the below and remove the trident and you'll look miles better than both.

comments.author: Livid_Shallot5701
comments.body: make the logo 3d, so it can rotate ver so slightly and fit the lightnig effortless

comments.author: Felfedezni
comments.body: Old is better. You wrnt overboard with the smoke. Just animating the old smoke and making the old lantern flicker would have been about perfect

comments.author: Pulkownik
comments.body: Was the music also made by AI? Sounds cool :)

replies.author: Glittering_Fig_762
replies.body:
The music is obviously ai

What model was used if you know? Yue2?

comments.author: dogscatsnscience
comments.body:
The top looks like generic low effort so it looks like every other AI game.

The bottom is a lot more interesting.

comments.author: KS-Wolf-1978
comments.body:
The top one SCREAMS ChatGPT, so you would have a hell of a time dealing with AI haters, who would instantly recognize it because it is used by so many people.

ChatGPT creates images with way too many completely unnecessary details human artists would never draw/paint.

comments.author: Chaose_ST
comments.body: The new version feels much more like an actual place in the game rather than just a menu background. The lighting is great too. I'd maybe give the menu text a little more contrast, but overall it's a big improvement

comments.author: ComSenseisnotCommon
comments.body: Old is definitely better in quality.

comments.author: m82a
comments.body: I think you should focus on other parts of the game, if there is still work to be done - the top menu was good enough. I even like it more, it is more focused and lighter.

comments.author: TheOtherDArnold
comments.body:
Man. First off both menus look great! This probably isn’t helpful, but if that bottom menu came out 12 months ago, I’d choose it. However, now it looks “just AI enough” to make me think about AI’s role in making the design. I don’t feel that way about the top menu.

You’ve done a great job with both.

comments.author: Ukawok92
comments.body: Bottom lookz better overall, but the scenery outside the window looks better on top.

comments.author: bigorangemachine
comments.body:
I think bottom is pretty good.

I generally like the top because you can see everything and my eye can explore.  That's just me tho

I think the bottom is good I even like the push on the menu to the side a bit more!  The only thing is that foreground flag is black.  I get it adds contrast but I can't see what it is so it just feels broody for the sake of broody.  I'd try to light it enough so you can see the colour.  If it's a black flag swap it for something with colour

comments.author: Emotional-Cut2952
comments.body: so above image is gpt image, then the below one still uses the gpt image trident, just use gemini NB2.1 it'll generate clean images without the gpt image artefacts/smudge

comments.author: CuteGoldenMonkey
comments.body: The old one looks much better

comments.author: algorfati
comments.body: hmm..  old one looks better..

comments.author: Friendly-West-244
comments.body: Thats dope !
